name: mdview
description: Click a .md path in the Claude Code conversation to read it rendered as markdown beside the session, pictures included, and point at any block to have Claude edit it.

clickOpens.title: Click opens
clickOpens.description: Outside Warp, what a click on a .md path in the conversation opens: pane = mdview's side pane; app = the app macOS opens .md files with

clickOpensInWarp.title: Click opens (Warp)
clickOpensInWarp.description: In Warp, what a click on a .md path in the conversation opens: warp = Warp's own Markdown viewer, split to the right; pane = mdview's side pane; app = the app macOS opens .md files with
